headword: {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}
gloss: acting on one's own authority; going it alone

definitions.gloss: acting on one's own authority; acting arbitrarily without consultation
definitions.explanation: Making decisions and taking action unilaterally without consulting others or seeking approval. Carries a negative connotation of overstepping authority.

examples.japanese: {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}は{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: Acting on your own authority is not permitted.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}の{独断専行|どくだんせんこう}に{部下|ぶか}たちは{不満|ふまん}を{募|つの}らせた。
examples.english: The subordinates grew increasingly frustrated with the department head's unilateral actions.

examples.japanese: {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}で{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}んでしまい、{会社|かいしゃ}に{大|おお}きな{損害|そんがい}を{与|あた}えた。
examples.english: By signing the contract without authorization, they caused great damage to the company.

notes:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) meaning to decide and act without consulting others. Composed of {独断|どくだん} (arbitrary decision) + {専行|せんこう} (acting on one's own). Almost always negative — implies overstepping boundaries or ignoring proper procedures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}する: to act arbitrarily
- {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}を{許|ゆる}す: to allow unilateral action
- {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}を{戒|いまし}める: to warn against acting alone
- {独断専行|どくだんせんこう}で{決|き}める: to decide unilaterally

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {独断|どくだん}: arbitrary decision — the decision alone, without the action
- {独|ひと}り{走|ばし}り: going off on one's own — more colloquial
- ワンマン: one-man (management style) — focuses on autocratic leadership
- {越権行為|えっけんこうい}: act of overstepping one's authority — legal/formal term
